mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_menu ORDER BY order_num, id

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.perms, m.menu_type, m.order_num FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{uid} AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') ORDER BY m.order_num, m.id
SELECT perms FROM sys_menu WHERE perms IS NOT NULL AND perms != ''
